records.title: MT-EditFlow: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing with Flow Matching
records.reason: Multi-turn image-editing flow-matching RL optimizes image-editing reward/training, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Scaling Agentic Capabilities via Grounded Interaction Synthesis
records.reason: Synthesizes grounded interaction data to improve agent capabilities; the cited ZeRO lineage does not reflect a memory/offload optimization in this work.

records.title: When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-ClassArchitectures
records.reason: Studies emergence of attention circuits and attention sinks across 1B language models; potentially adjacent to attention/KV behavior but does not propose or evaluate an inference optimization.

records.title: Pulse: Training Acceleration for Large Diffusion Models with Automatic Pipeline Parallelism
records.reason: Automatic pipeline parallelism accelerates training of large diffusion models; ZeRO lineage is training-only and this does not concern language-model inference.

records.title: PEARL: Performance-Efficient Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Through Learned Orchestration
records.reason: The title/abstract indicate learned orchestration for cost-efficient agentic RAG and a FrugalGPT relation, but publisher DOI source could not be retrieved for primary-text confirmation.
